Topic 15.2: Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUSOMA 15.2.1 UFUPISHO
This lesson teaches Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho for Grade 9 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho

2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

2. Explain Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 15.2.1 Ufupisho important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.
